name: Glue_Grenade
display_fullname: V Arachnos Warden Weaver Glue Grenade
display_help:
The Weaver Grenade is an experimental ordanance that uses nanites to create toxic webs that completely ensnare a target.

In the first stage, targets will be inflicted with Toxic Damage over time. In the second stage, targets will become Immobilized by webbing that grows over them. In the final stage, targets will have their movement and attack rate completely paralyzed.
